Rules.title: The rules in 30 seconds
Rules.step1: Two players take turns drawing one line between two neighbouring dots.
Rules.step2: Draw the fourth side of a box and it is yours — and you get to draw again.
Rules.step3: Keep capturing, keep moving; the first line that closes nothing ends your turn.
Rules.step4: When no lines are left, count the boxes. Most boxes wins.
Rules.tip: Tip: never rush to draw the third side of a box — that is how you gift it to your opponent.

Guide.title: What is Dots and Boxes online? An easy guide to Ô Kìa
Guide.intro1: Dots and Boxes is the classic pen-and-paper game from school days: two players share a sheet of grid paper, take turns drawing one line at a time, and whoever closes a box claims it. Ô Kìa is Dots and Boxes online: open okia.io.vn and play right away on your phone or computer, with nothing to install and no paper needed.
Guide.intro2: The rules fit in a few lines, but the strategy runs deep: the player who can count chains and think a few moves ahead wins the endgame. Practise against the computer, invite friends to a private room, or play ranked against players everywhere.
Guide.rulesIntro: You only need to remember four things:
Guide.rule1: Start: the board is a grid of dots with no lines yet.
Guide.rule2: Your turn: draw exactly one line joining two neighbouring dots, horizontally or vertically.
Guide.rule3: Capture: drawing the fourth side of a box makes it yours and you draw again. Keep capturing and you keep going; a line that captures nothing ends your turn.
Guide.rule4: End: when no lines are left, count the boxes; more boxes wins. Every board on Ô Kìa has an odd number of boxes, so games never end in a draw.
Guide.howTitle: How to play Dots and Boxes online on Ô Kìa
Guide.how1: You get a guest account the moment you arrive, no sign-up needed. To learn, press <bot>Play vs Bot</bot>. To play a friend, create a <room>Private Room</room> and send the code or link over any chat app; they tap it and they are in, even as guests.
Guide.how2: Once you are comfortable, sign in with Google to play Ranked, earn rewards and keep your rank, Lead and skins across devices.
Guide.modesIntro: Pick the mode that fits your mood:
Guide.mode1Desc: Practise any time without waiting. The computer captures boxes, sacrifices chains and reads the endgame. Win 3 in a row and it plays tighter; lose 3 in a row and it eases off, so it always matches you.
Guide.mode2Desc: Get matched with players of your level on a random board, 30 seconds per turn. Wins earn rank points and Lead. If nobody close to your level shows up for a while, you are matched with the computer for half rank points. Requires a Google account.
Guide.mode3Desc: Pick the board and turn time (15, 30, 60 seconds or no limit), then invite exactly who you want.
Guide.mode4Desc: Each season lasts 8 weeks. Climb from Scratch Paper through Notebook, Good Student and Honor Student to Valedictorian; the 100 highest-scoring Valedictorians carry the Top Scholar title.
Guide.boards: Ô Kìa has square 5×5 and 7×7 boards plus playful shaped ones: Dinosaur, Flower, Octopus, Cactus and Ghost. Choose "Random" to draw a different board every game.
Guide.reward1: Lead: earned by winning ranked games, daily check-ins and daily or weekly quests.
Guide.reward2: Merit flowers: earned by checking in 7 days in a row or finishing weekly quests; used to buy gold-tier skins.
Guide.reward3: Visit the Shop for pen skins (stroke, capture sound, COMBO effect) and captured box skins. Skins are cosmetic only, never pay-to-win, and all of them are earned by playing.
Guide.onlineTitle: Things to remember when playing online
Guide.online1: Out of time: in timed games, if you do not move in time the server draws a line for you.
Guide.online2: Missed turns: letting the clock run out 3 turns in a row loses the game; leaving mid-game also counts as a loss.
Guide.online3: No reward for early wins: if your opponent times out, or resigns before move 10, you still win but get no Lead.
Guide.benefitsTitle: Why play Dots and Boxes online
Guide.benefit1: Sharpens your thinking: count chains, plan ahead, know when to give a little.
Guide.benefit2: Quick games: a 5×5 game takes just a few minutes, perfect for a break.
Guide.benefit3: Brings friends together: one link and the whole group can play, no app to install.
Guide.benefit4: Completely free: no top-ups, nothing to buy to win.
Guide.tip1: Count sides before you draw: if a box already has two sides, your third line is a gift to your opponent.
Guide.tip2: Late in the game the board is just "chains" of boxes. Give away the shortest chain and keep the long ones for yourself.
Guide.tip3: Take almost a whole chain, then deliberately leave the last two boxes so your opponent must open the next chain; experts call it the double-cross.
Guide.tip4: Turn on "Highlight opponent's last move" when choosing a board so you never miss a new line.
Guide.ctaLine: Ready to draw your first line? Play Dots and Boxes online on Ô Kìa now!

About.title: About Ô Kìa
About.p1: Ô Kìa is a personal project born from nostalgia for grid-paper notebooks covered in little squares. The goal is simple: bring the box-capturing game to the web so that opening a link is enough to play, smoothly and satisfyingly, against the bot or with friends.
About.p2: The game is completely free. Every item is cosmetic and earned by playing; there is no top-up and no paying to win. Ô Kìa shows a few ads outside of matches to pay for the server; accounts that have supported see no ads.
About.p3: If you enjoy Ô Kìa, invite one more friend to play. That is the best support we could ask for.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.p1: When you play as a guest, Ô Kìa only stores a random device id in your browser to remember your session. No name, email or phone number is required.
Privacy.p2: When you sign in with Google we store your display name, avatar (if any), email and Google id. Email is only used to identify your account and send welcome/security mail; there is no password to store. No marketing email.
Privacy.p3: Ô Kìa uses third-party services for transactional email and error monitoring, hosted outside Vietnam. Only the minimum data needed for those services to work is sent.
Privacy.p4: You can delete your account at any time from the settings; data is hidden immediately and permanently deleted after 30 days.
Privacy.p5: Ô Kìa shows Google AdSense ads to cover server costs. Google and its partners use cookies and advertising identifiers to pick ads based on your visits to this and other sites; you can opt out of personalised ads at Google Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com). Accounts that have supported Ô Kìa see no ads and load no ad code.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.p1: Ô Kìa is a free, non-commercial game. Play, share the link and invite friends as much as you like.
Terms.p2: No cheating: using multiple accounts to fix results, automating moves or exploiting bugs leads to a ban and voided results.
Terms.p3: Be kind: display names must not contain offensive words; in-game emotes are for fun only.
Terms.p4: In-game items have no monetary value and cannot be bought, sold or traded outside the game.

Ranked.title: Ranked
Ranked.intro: Matched with players at your level, random board, 30 seconds per turn. Win to earn Lead and climb.
Ranked.widened: Search range widened. A mismatched game moves very few points (maybe just ±1).
Ranked.widenHint: The longer you wait, the wider the search.
Ranked.inGame: You have a game in progress, taking you back…
Ranked.guestBody: Ranked is for real accounts so your rank and Lead survive a device change. Guests can still play the bot and private rooms.
Ranked.topTier: Valedictorian — reach the top 100 for Top Scholar!
Ranked.noHistory: No ranked games this season yet.
Ranked.noReward: No Lead (missed turns or resigned too early)
Ranked.notSettled: This game could not be scored. Your rank is unchanged.
Ranked.how1: Wins add points, losses take some away; points never go below zero. Even games add more than they take, so steady play climbs.
Ranked.how2: Matchmaking uses a hidden skill rating. When few players are online it accepts a skill gap, but the bigger the gap, the fewer points change hands.
Ranked.how3: Your first 5 games each season are placement games with no rank shown. Each tier has 3 divisions (III → I). Valedictorian is the top tier; its 100 highest scorers hold the Top Scholar title.
Ranked.how4: A season lasts 8 weeks. When a new one starts your rank points are halved and you play 5 placement games again.
Ranked.topScholar: Top Scholar — top 100 of the whole school!

skins.confirmReplace: Replace the whole catalog with this file (skins missing from the file are deleted, defaults kept)? Cancel to only add / overwrite.
skins.metaOnlyHint: Only name, description, rarity, order and enabled can be edited here. Stroke, effects and bundled files are part of the package: export it, edit, and import again.
skins.previewHint: Nothing is written yet. Cards look exactly as in the shop; press Try to see stroke, box, debris and sounds on the sample board straight from the zip. Import when happy.
skins.previewBadJson: JSON file is not a skin manifest (missing id / type / rarity / name / description).
skins.editPreviewHint: The card on the left updates as you type — this is what players will see after Save.
skins.confirmPurge: Delete every non-default skin (including disabled ones)? Owners keep their inventory: re-importing the same id restores it. Export all (.zip) first.
skins.previewReplace: Replace the whole catalog: delete skins not in this package (except defaults)

cfg.intro: Each setting shows the value in effect and the default; type a new value and press Save (only changed settings are sent; changed fields turn yellow). Takes effect within 15 s of saving.
cfg.ranked_win_lead_hint: 0 = no reward. Also applies to bot games.
cfg.ranked_turn_seconds_hint: Applies to games opened after saving; games in progress keep their timer.
cfg.mm_accept_seconds_hint: The countdown to press Play now.
cfg.mm_rematch_grace_seconds_hint: During the first N seconds of waiting prefer someone else; after that (or at the bot threshold) rematch anyway. Keep it below the bot threshold.
cfg.mm_unlimited_after_seconds_hint: Drops the hidden-rating window after N seconds; lopsided games move very few points.
cfg.chat_enabled_hint: Off → everyone is read-only and the composer says chat is closed.
cfg.chat_dup_seconds_hint: The same text (case-insensitive) within N seconds is rejected. 0 = off.
cfg.ads_mock_hint: Show "AD here" frames at the real ad positions: home below the signboard and below the button row, end of Shop / Leaderboard, two rails at the edges of wide PC screens, and the interstitial on New game. Non-supporters and admins see them; players need to reload.
cfg.ads_interstitial_every_hint: On New game / Play again after a finished game. 0 = off. Players need to reload.
cfg.guest_per_ip_per_hour: Max guest accounts per hour per IP
cfg.guest_per_ip_per_hour_hint: Mobile networks share one IP across many people — don't set it too low.
cfg.mmBotAfterHint: 0 = never. Empty = use the MM_BOT_AFTER_SECONDS environment variable (45).
cfg.rarityPriceHint: Lead / flowers (or both). Current shown as Lead/Flowers. Applies to the shop immediately.
cfg.checkinRewardsHint: At least one currency per day. Current shown as Lead/Flowers.
cfg.disconnect_grace_seconds_hint: Mid-game disconnect: the turn clock pauses for N seconds to reconnect; after that the player forfeits.
